sourceEvidence.detail: ThreadListParams has no includeEmptyPreview option; section/relation filters are scoped.
push_thread_filters_with_preview excludes empty preview from ordinary nonarchived lists; parent/ancestor use thread_spawn_edges, not ordinary fork lineage.
Default interactive sources and profile session directories.
SessionMeta.id/forked_from_id/attached_thread confirm ordinary fork; inherited messages need not be read.
Native can transparently read .jsonl.zst; Web leaves compressed candidate identity/decompression to native thread/read.

implementation.query: Current CODEX_HOME fixed-version SQLite opened mode=ro and query_only; empty-preview nonarchived interactive nonattached candidate IDs/path only.
implementation.plainMetadata: Current profile sessions/archived_sessions realpath and inode checks, 2 MiB first SessionMeta line maximum, no message scan or contents returned.
implementation.compressedMetadata: Existing bounded compressed path is candidate only; frontend must verify actual native forkedFromId and !ephemeral.
implementation.webOwnedIndex: Observed hints remain a separate atomic profile-local index. Old candidates are not written to it by discovery.
implementation.failureBehavior: Busy, corrupt, wrong schema, invalid/outside/symlink paths and timeout produce explicit errors. Native archive/delete file move race skips stale candidate. No silent result truncation.
implementation.performance: Selective empty-preview metadata query with 10-second explicit budget and per-file inode/mtime/size header cache; no full rollout scan.
implementation.multiTenant: Scope is current process CODEX_HOME, no host scans. Per-tenant CODEX_HOME/filesystem/process isolation still required; this is not authorization isolation.

limits: Compressed candidate detection is covered by isolated fixtures; full native/browser workflow validates plain real forks. Native remains responsible for compressed contents and true fork identity.
10-second query budget errors explicitly for oversized/slow native stores; not an unbounded metadata scrape.
